session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: Hey Marco! Good to see you. How was the trip to Porto?

session_1.speaker: Marco
session_1.text: Porto was lovely, mostly rain though. I spent two days in bookshops and ate far too many pastries.

session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: That sounds like my kind of holiday. I've been stuck at work on the quarterly report.

session_1.speaker: Marco
session_1.text: Ouch. At least the weather here has been kind. Any plans for the weekend?

session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: Just the market and maybe a long walk if it stays dry.

session_2.speaker: Marco
session_2.text: Guess what, I ran the Riverside half marathon on Sunday!

session_2.speaker: Priya
session_2.text: No way, congratulations! How did it go?

session_2.speaker: Marco
session_2.text: Two hours and four minutes. My knees have opinions about it today.

session_2.speaker: Priya
session_2.text: Well earned. I've started a pottery class on Tuesday evenings, by the way. My first bowl looks like a hat.

session_2.speaker: Marco
session_2.text: A hat is a start. Bring one to the picnic in May.

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: I signed up for the pottery class properly now, a whole term. The teacher, Noor, is brilliant.

session_3.speaker: Marco
session_3.text: That's great. Did you decide about the car in the end?

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: Not yet. The mechanic says the old one has another year in it, so I'm waiting.

session_3.speaker: Marco
session_3.text: Sensible. I'm thinking of repainting the flat this month, the hallway especially.

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: Pick a colour that hides scuffs. Trust me.

session_4.speaker: Marco
session_4.text: Hallway is painted. Sage green, no scuffs so far.

session_4.speaker: Priya
session_4.text: Very grown up. We had a team day at work, a cooking class, which was more fun than I expected.

session_4.speaker: Priya
session_4.text: A ridiculous number of dumplings. Everyone took some home.

session_4.speaker: Marco
session_4.text: I'd have volunteered for that. Picnic is still on for the 12th of May?

session_5.speaker: Priya
session_5.text: That picnic was perfect. Thanks for organising the food.

session_5.speaker: Marco
session_5.text: Thanks for the bowl! It does look slightly like a hat, but a very nice hat.

session_5.speaker: Priya
session_5.text: I'll take it. Noor says my second one is actually round.

session_5.speaker: Marco
session_5.text: Progress. I have booked a week in the mountains for June, finally.

session_6.speaker: Marco
session_6.text: Morning! I've started cycling to work three days a week. My legs are complaining but the mornings are nice.

session_6.speaker: Priya
session_6.text: Good for you. I'm on holiday from Friday, two weeks of doing very little.

session_6.speaker: Priya
session_6.text: My aunt's place by the lake. Books, swimming, and no quarterly reports.

When did Priya start her pottery class?
What did Marco say about his trip to Japan?
qa.adversarial_answer: He loved the temples in Kyoto
